questions.question:
Which refund applies to **this order**?

- Order 4417
- Nine days late

options.title: Full refund
options.explanation: The policy covers a delivery this late.

options.title: Store credit
options.explanation: The customer keeps the order, so no return is needed.

options.title: The shop
options.explanation: The late delivery is the shop's fault.

options.title: The customer
options.explanation: The terms of sale say the customer pays.
